integrity: The polar identity, maximum contact classification, area asymptotics and critical time laws have an analytic proof; finite numerical checks are supplementary. Integrability and phase portraits were established in prior research. Originality is evidence-bounded; independent audit is not performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to nonzero homogeneous cubic radial terms in the planar unit-angular-speed rigid family; it does not treat general linear-plus-cubic perturbations, subleading disk-area corrections, or all subcritical tangency blow-up rates.
title: Two sharp area-growth exponents at quartic rigid isochronous centers
